blocks.prompt: 1. A window consists of a rectangle surmounted by a semicircular opening. If the total perimeter is 21 meter, find the dimensions that maximize the area.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh optimization ka sawal hai jis mein area ko maximum (sab se bara) karna hai, taa ke khidki se zyada se zyada roshni aaye.
Diya kya hai? Khidki ka poora kinara (perimeter) 21 meter hai: neeche rectangle, upar semicircle (aadha daira).
Find kya karna hai? Woh chaurai aur oonchai jin se area sab se zyada ho.
Rule kaunsa? Perimeter wali shart se aik variable hatana, phir \(\frac{dA}{dr} = 0\) aur second derivative test.
Plan: semicircle ka radius \(r\) lenge (to chaurai \(2r\)), rectangle ki oonchai \(h\); perimeter se \(h\) nikal kar area ko sirf \(r\) mein likhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: khidki = rectangle + upar semicircle; perimeter = 21 m.
Maloom karna: maximum area wali dimensions.
Tareeqa: area do letters (\(r\), \(h\)) par depend karta hai; fixed perimeter aik letter hata deta hai. Phir \(\frac{dA}{dr} = 0\) aur second derivative test.

Variables rakhein
\(r\) = semicircle ka radius (meter), is liye rectangle ki chaurai \(2r\); \(h\) = rectangle ki oonchai (meter).
Kyun: semicircle rectangle ki upar wali side par baitha hai, is liye us ka diameter rectangle ki chaurai ke barabar hai. Figure (answer sketch) dekhiye.

Constraint (perimeter)
\[2r + 2h + \pi r = 21\]
\[h = \dfrac{21 - 2r - \pi r}{2} \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: kinare par chalein to neeche \(2r\), dono taraf \(h + h\), aur upar gol arc milti hai jo poore daire ki aadhi circumference hai: \(\frac{1}{2}(2\pi r) = \pi r\).
Dhyan dein: rectangle ki upar wali seedhi line khidki ke andar hai, kinare par nahi, is liye use perimeter mein nahi ginte. Yeh sab se aam ghalti hai.

Area ko aik variable mein likhein
\[A = 2rh + \dfrac{1}{2}\pi r^{2} \quad \text{...(2)}\]
\[A = r(21 - 2r - \pi r) + \dfrac{1}{2}\pi r^{2}\]
\[A = 21r - 2r^{2} - \dfrac{1}{2}\pi r^{2} \quad \text{...(3)}\]
Kyun: rectangle ka area \(2r \times h\) aur semicircle ka area poore daire ka aadha \(\frac{1}{2}\pi r^{2}\). (1) se \(2rh = r(21 - 2r - \pi r)\) rakha, phir \(-\pi r^{2} + \frac{1}{2}\pi r^{2} = -\frac{1}{2}\pi r^{2}\) jama kiya.

Critical point
\[\dfrac{dA}{dr} = 21 - 4r - \pi r = 21 - (4 + \pi)r\]
\[21 - (4 + \pi)r = 0\]
\[r = \dfrac{21}{4 + \pi} \approx 2.94\text{ m}\]
Kyun: maximum par graph ki dhalwan (slope) zero hoti hai. \(21r\) ka derivative 21, \(-2r^{2}\) ka \(-4r\), aur \(-\frac{1}{2}\pi r^{2}\) ka \(-\pi r\). Phir \(4r\) aur \(\pi r\) mein \(r\) common nikal kar \((4 + \pi)r\) likha.

Second derivative test
\[\dfrac{d^{2}A}{dr^{2}} = -(4 + \pi) < 0\]
Kyun: second derivative negative hai (aur yeh \(r\) par depend bhi nahi karta, yani graph har jagah neeche ki taraf mura hua hai), is liye \(r = \frac{21}{4 + \pi}\) par area maximum hai.

Dimensions nikalein
\[h = \dfrac{21 - (2 + \pi)\frac{21}{4 + \pi}}{2} = \dfrac{1}{2}\cdot\dfrac{42}{4 + \pi}\]
\[h = \dfrac{21}{4 + \pi} \approx 2.94\text{ m}\]
\[2r = \dfrac{42}{4 + \pi} \approx 5.88\text{ m}\]
Kyun: \(r\) ko (1) mein rakha. Common denominator lene par upar \(21(4 + \pi) - 21(2 + \pi) = 84 - 42 = 42\) bachta hai. Natija: \(h = r\), yani behtareen khidki ka rectangle oonchai se dugna chaura hota hai.

Maximum area aur tasdeeq
\[A_{\max} = \dfrac{441}{2(4 + \pi)} \approx 30.88\text{ m}^{2}\]
\[2r + 2h + \pi r = (4 + \pi)r = 21\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: (3) ko \(A = r\left(21 - \frac{(4 + \pi)r}{2}\right)\) likh kar \(r\) rakha: \(\frac{21}{4 + \pi}\cdot\frac{21}{2}\). Aur \(h = r\) ke saath perimeter \((4 + \pi)r\) banta hai jo bilkul 21 hai, yani shart poori hai.
blocks.final_answer: Rectangle ki chaurai \(2r = \frac{42}{4 + \pi} \approx 5.88\) m, rectangle ki oonchai \(h = \frac{21}{4 + \pi} \approx 2.94\) m, semicircle ka radius \(\frac{21}{4 + \pi} \approx 2.94\) m; maximum area \(\frac{441}{2(4 + \pi)} \approx 30.88\text{ m}^{2}\).

answer_figure.alt: Khidki ki tasveer: neeche rectangle aur upar semicircle (aadha daira). Rectangle ki chaurai 2r, takreeban 5.88 m, aur oonchai h jo r ke barabar hai, takreeban 2.94 m; semicircle ka radius r. Perimeter 2r + 2h + pi r = 21 m.
